nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: TESTING MODE: every 5 minutes. Run either this trigger or crontab.txt / `npm run cron`, never both, or every symbol gets queried twice.

nodes.name: Called By Supervisor
nodes.notes: Entry point used by 'screener-mcp :: supervisor' once the MCP server reports healthy.

nodes.name: Skipped Or Failed
nodes.notes: Scrape failed, or the page listed no companies at all.

nodes.name: Scrape + MCP
nodes.notes: Scrapes Moneycontrol, resolves NSE symbols and runs the 19-call MCP dump per symbol, all in-process. The body is n8n-workflows/scrape-and-dump.js — edit that file and run `npm run n8n:sync`, don't edit it here. JavaScript, so nothing has to be installed in the n8n container. Enrichment stops at DEADLINE_MS=40000 to stay under the ~60s task timeout, and the starting symbol rotates each tick so successive runs cover the rest.

nodes.name: Companies
nodes.notes: One item per company, each carrying its own MCP dump under `mcp`.
